verdict.rationale: Granola ships some built-in background automations. Notes added to folders can be set to auto-save to HubSpot records, briefs are prepared overnight, and follow-up emails are drafted automatically after external meetings. Its Zapier integration also advertises automating post-meeting steps. However, Granola Chat workflows include a review step before anything is sent, and there is no documented general-purpose, user-defined automation builder or scheduler inside the product. missing for 10: a native configurable automation or trigger builder, recurring scheduled agent runs, autonomous execution without manual review, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: You can set up Granola to automatically save any notes that are added to Granola folders to the relevant contacts, companies, or deals on HubSpot.
Granola preps you for your meetings overnight.
After an external meeting, Granola can automatically draft a follow-up email
Connect Granola to 8,000+ apps and automate what happens after a meeting
